# [TASK] Live-verify ai-service against the real stack (Ollama, Postman/newman, e2e-smoke scope)

## Task
Live-verify ai-service's three Ollama-backed endpoints (recommendations, chat, semantic search) through the real gateway. Speech-to-text (#68) and the gateway-routing bug that blocked ai-service (#69) were already fixed and out of scope here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Root `README.md` documents the Ollama model-pull step for both models used (`README.md`: `ollama pull llama3.2`, `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`)
- [x] The Postman collection has an ai-service folder covering recommendations, chat and semantic search, chained off the bearer token from the auth folder (`docs/api/LMDB-API.postman_collection.json`, folder "15. AI Service (#48)")
- [x] All three endpoints resolve `lb://movie-service` through Eureka via a hand-attached load-balancer interceptor scoped to downstream clients, not a bean that would also catch Eureka's or Ollama's own client (`RestClientConfig`, `AiServiceIntegrationTest`)
- [x] `smoke-test.sh` lists ai-service in its health targets and pulls both Ollama models before the smoke run (`infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** not estimated (closed before hour estimates were required)

## Notes
- Found and fixed a real bug in the process: a `@LoadBalanced` `RestClient` bean never resolved `lb://` URIs, so `lb://movie-service` threw and recommendations silently returned an empty list. `RestClientConfig` now attaches `BlockingLoadBalancerInterceptor` by hand to a private `RestClient.Builder` per downstream, only when that downstream's base URL uses the `lb` scheme, so Eureka's own registration client and Spring AI's Ollama client are unaffected.
- Known limitation: recommendations occasionally return HTTP 500 because `llama3.2` (no strict JSON mode) sometimes returns non-JSON output; retrying the same request succeeds. Confirmed as model output variability, not a wiring bug. No follow-up issue filed.
- Speech-to-text is out of scope here — covered by #68/#69.
